overview:
Shadechester FC, with a TOTW performance this week, saw them move back up to 2nd place and close the gap on eternal leaders Try hard FC, whose lead has been reduced to a 'still not insignificant' 45pts. Yorkshire Lass UTD also had an impressive week and have moved up to 3rd place, leapfrogging Norfolk N Chance.

There were also a bunch of movements in the top half of the table, however no single team gained a clear and meaningful points advantage. chicken caesar salah had another good week after their TOTW performance last week, scoring 47pts and moving into the top half of the table for the first time since GW5.

It still remains close in the top half of the table, with only 11 points separating 2nd to 4th places and only 29 points separating 5th to 10th places.

Many teams were blindsided this week by the fact that highly selected midfielders Semenyo and Caicedo didn't play due to injury and rotation respectively. This meant many teams this week had to rely on their subs for points and it probably explains what has been a fairly low scoring week.
totwDescription: Shadechester FC are the highest point scorers of GW12, with 59pts and pick up their second TOTW in 3 weeks. Player of the Week Eze provided a big chunk of the points for Jade's team this week, but decent scores across their defence plus a goal for Danny Welbeck also contributed to their points total. Nice one Jade 🙌🏻
sackedDescription: Stranger Mings receive the wooden spoon of doom this week, having scored the lowest score of 24pts. It marks a continued decline in form for Gaz's team as they have dropped from 2nd to 9th in 5 game weeks. No goals or assists and only one clean sheet from Guéhi meant low scores across the whole team this week. Better luck next week Gaz 🙏🏻

otherUpdates.title: 👌🏻 Player of the Week
otherUpdates.content: Eberechi Eze (ARS 🔴⚪ - £7.7m) is this week's POTW with 20pts after scoring a hat-trick against local rivals Spurs. He has a TSB% of 15.1% but is only selected by 2 of the 20 teams in our league, Shadechester FC and Under my Cucurella who both had 2 of the highest point scores this week mostly thanks to Eze.

otherUpdates.title: 🤔 Feedback
otherUpdates.content: I would love your feedback on these updates - anything you like, dislike or would like to see more of? Maybe you've got a shout out, a grudge you want to air or something else you would like included in the update - just let me know via the WhatsApp group and I'll add it to the update for the following week.

otherUpdates.title: ⏭️ Next Gameweek
otherUpdates.content: The deadline for locking in teams, transfers and chips for GW13 is Saturday 29th November at 1:30pm.
